_note: World-space teammate markers, teammate waypoints and map pins. stale_after_seconds = a teammate's last sample older than this starts to dim; stale_full_seconds = the age at which it is as dim as it gets (stale_min_alpha); gone_seconds = older than this and the marker is dropped. show_distance = metres a distance is written under the name; max_distance = past this no marker is drawn. edge_margin = pixels between the screen edge and an edge arrow; edge_arrow_size = arrow half-length in design units. font_size and outline in design units. down_label and caught_label are the words shown instead of the distance (upper case). other_floor_alpha_* = how strongly a pin on another floor is drawn on the minimap and the full map (never dropped). down_ring_hz = pulses a second of the ring round a downed teammate's pin; down_ring_radius = ring radius in cells (at least the pin's radius). ping_seconds = how long a quick-chat map ping lasts (fades out over the whole time); ping_radius = its biggest ring in cells. waypoint = the per-player waypoint: chevron_spacing and chevron_count are the world-space chevrons drawn from a teammate's marker toward its waypoint; max_range = metres the waypoint may be set from; label = the word above it; pin_alpha = map pin strength.
